summary: 51 Colorado National Guardsmen, first responders, and civilians (+5 pets) stopped by rising floodwaters in Lyons ~4:20 p.m.; high-mobility trucks could not ford the water; CH-47 Chinook and UH-60 Black Hawk (4th Combat Aviation Brigade) evacuated all 10 civilians and their pets plus a number of responders/Guardsmen before weather shut down flights again; 15 first responders/Guardsmen waited out the flood on high ground
responding_agency: 4th Combat Aviation Brigade (CH-47 Chinook, UH-60 Black Hawk); Colorado National Guard
notes: Story datelined 2013-09-16, events 'yesterday' -> 2013-09-15 (Sunday-verified); September 2013 Front Range flood cluster.
